title: A convex body variant of Soberon's counterexample to the Grünbaum conjecture.
abstract: A Lean formalization of a geometric strengthening/variant of Pablo Soberón's counterexample to the Grünbaum four-hyperplane mass-partition conjecture. The formalized result constructs a convex body K in R^4 with nonempty interior such that no four affine hyperplanes divide K into sixteen sign cells of equal four-dimensional volume.  Equivalently, the obstructed mass can be chosen to be uniform Lebesgue volume on a convex body.  The proof adapts Soberón's explicit cubic/quartic tensor obstruction and replaces the smooth positive density used in the source by a small Wulff-body perturbation of the Euclidean ball.
